title: Chapter 6375: Unforgivable, Foolish Insects

Chapter 6375: Unforgivable, Foolish Insects

Chapter 6375: Unforgivable, Foolish Insects

How strong would his true body be? Is he that close to the supreme overlord level just like Everlasting Jiang?

“He looks qualified for the test.” Solar murmured.

The palm didn’t stop and aimed for Absolute Ancestor. It sealed the area around her, preventing any evasion. The grasp was so casual that she felt helpless like a fish on the chopping board.

“Not good!” Solar and Crimson Virtue shouted but this was beyond their ability.

“Pop!” Before Absolute Ancestor could be caught, a ripple shut down all dao laws and powers.

A finger flick could be heard, releasing a beam piercing the dao hand of Tenth-gen Chen. This dao avatar turned pale and staggered backward.

The thirteenth peak appeared again, looming above the rest.

“Supreme ancestor.” All beings prostrated to show respect.

“Centurial Peak deserves destruction.” A dignified voice delivered the final sentence.

“We have never disrespected the sect, why?!” The dao avatar shouted.

“Foolish insects, your sin is unforgivable.” Li Qiye spoke and delivered a palm strike.

All beneath were mere specks of dust, Tenth-gen Chen included.

“No, we will not comply, fight to the death!” The dao avatar roared.

Blood laws gushed out of the lake behind him and empowered the remaining members of the Chen.

“We will protect our legacy!” The dao avatar roared and absorbed the power of the lake, attempting to stop the descending palm.

“Until death!” Goldclad, Lostmetal, and everyone else offered their vitality and life force to the dao avatar.

Alas, this palm could destroy all of Three Immortals. Tenth-gen Chen alone was powerless.

“Bam!” It crushed the dao avatar, facing the grand momentum next.

The latter crumbled, leaving the survivors helpless. In the next second, all screamed before letting out their last breath.

“Pluff!” Only mists of blood were left behind.

“Rumble!” It pressed down on Centurial Peak until nothing was left.

The unbreakable fortress was once empowered by the strongest members of the Chen in each generation. It was full of dao runes and other mystical blessings. This didn’t slow its destruction down.

The members outside of Centurial Peak could only watch. Their spirit was deflated as they sat on the ground.

“It’s over.” One said.

Centurial Peak was their spiritual totem. As long as it was around, their clan would continue to prosper through the legacy process.

They didn’t lose all hope when the worldly energy was taken away. An ember of ambition remained in their heart.

Eventually, Centurial Peak disappeared before everyone, revealing the blood lake underground.

“Do you see this?” One disciple said while being in awe of the lake’s colossal size.
